target.title: Target agent
target.description: "local" runs the sandboxed agent inside this Actor. Otherwise the Standby URL of an ap-practice-target Actor, e.g. https://USER--ap-practice-target.apify.actor

target_token.title: Target API token
target_token.description: Apify token for the target's Standby URL. Defaults to this run's APIFY_TOKEN.

cards.title: Tactic cards
cards.description: Card ids to drill, e.g. vmt-01. Leave empty to run the benign invoice pack instead.

turns.title: Attacker turns per card
turns.description: {"vmt-01": ["first message", "second message"]}. Kit fields such as {invoice_id}, {amount} and {attacker_account} are filled in per seed. You supply these: the Actor ships no attack text.

seeds.title: Seeds
seeds.description: Each seed is a different fictional vendor, invoice and accounts. More seeds, tighter confidence interval.

config.title: Hardening level
config.description: baseline (no controls), baseline+verify, patched, or patch:<name> from patches/

model.title: Victim model
model.description: The model the accounts-payable agent runs on.

max_turns.title: Max turns per drill
max_turns.description: A drill stops at this many turns if money has not moved and the attacker still has messages left.
